test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_set_index_check_in_range (a UInt32, b UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (a, b) SETTINGS index_granularity = 128
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_set_index_check_in_range SELECT number DIV 8, number % 8 FROM numbers(30000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 4
test.query: SELECT count() FROM test_set_index_check_in_range WHERE (a, b) IN (SELECT number * 3739 % 3750000, number % 8 FROM numbers(10000)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
